model.stratum: Forward coordinate realization and displayed incidence compatibility: the shared directed windows in separate Cartesian and tetrahedral3D lattices, on a five-vertex regular4-simplex, and in the retained facet/barycenter proposal. Numerical geometry/browser tests, not physical carrier identification or readout descent.
consumes: Existing regular4-simplex coordinates and local Three.js/OrbitControls; operator-requested Cartesian lattice x=realization,z=codimension,y unused; tetrahedral clone extends the60degree CMC plane by a periodic Freudenthal volume triangulation, retaining each window as one elementary face; volume cells are equal-volume and non-regular; tetrahedral scene renders exactly one lattice bounded to Euclidean radius4 about C1, with no separate plane grid; projected fifth vertex C2 must stay strictly inside the outer tetrahedron
provides: All views use an orthographic3D-to-screen camera;4D views use only a rotated orthogonal4D-to-3D projection. Separate Cartesian/hexagonal lattice views retain shared route/progress selection and unrestricted orbit; the CMC plane is triangulated uniformly and every carrier window is a shared face of two tetrahedra in a conforming mesh, displayed as one complete-cell subset inside radius4. Five original tetrahedral boundary cells and earlier barycenter mode remain available.
missing_constructors: Native carrier/codimension identifications and physical meanings for unused axes remain absent; Cartesian/hexagonal coordinate roles are declared display choices, while C2-as-vertex and C2-as-barycenter remain separate models
model.next_falsifier: A rendered tetrahedral scene contains multiple lattices or geometry outside radius4; a volume mesh has an unpaired interior face, wrong total volume, or a carrier window that is not a tetrahedral face; a triangular-view window is not exactly one coordinate-grid cell, a view changes a shared-edge direction or merges distinct walk carriers, C2 is mislabelled between vertex/barycenter modes, a boundary cell is missing, projected segment scale depends on camera depth, or an offline browser interaction fails.
